designer-initial.summary: Selected a distinct medium battery-evidence and charge-qualification supervisor with exact 8/21/20/7 semantics, closed finite partitions, one charge-session state owner, and explicit cancel-over-recovery priority.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL forms contain all eight behavioral semantic usages directly beneath one root System, or is exactly one behavior-free Process plus separately counted delegation routing required while preserving the semantic 8/21 allocation?

Can GUMBO express the pre-state ChargeSessionState feedback, fully assigned finite ChargeSessionSnapshot and PilotBatteryStatus records, and the exact 20 owner-local cases without weakening or merging their partitions?

Can the retained bounded analyzer exhaust all 720 raw boundary/pre-state combinations and the declared owner-local products, including 1,620 type-valid PilotBatteryStatusPolicy combinations, with reachability reported separately?

diversity.selected_primary_scope: Battery evidence and charge qualification supervision with logical charge-permission session control
diversity.closest_baseline: Accepted replicate-1 Medium Drone Lifecycle Governor organized around Off/Standby/Charging/Ready/Flying transition governance
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: The selected boundary has no lifecycle request, lifecycle transition output, general power command, or flight authorization; lifecycle is read-only context. Its sole state is an IDLE/ENABLED/SUSPENDED charge-permission session, its evidence branches converge on charge eligibility and status, cancellation outranks charge revocation and request, and recovery suspends only charge permission until a fresh eligible request. Those choices remain a recognizable battery/charging purpose even without lifecycle ownership.

model-review.summary: The 8/21/20/7 allocation is realizable and has no identity-wrapper usage, but containment, repeated record classifiers, and CASE-20 totality need local resolution before generation.

findings.evidence: Trusted Isolette and retained well-formed campaign sources use System-to-Process-to-Thread containment, and a retained current-tool report records rejection of Threads directly beneath System. With six distinct root inputs, four root outputs, and 21 Process-local INT connections, the supported mapping is one uncredited Process, ten root/Process routes, depth two, nine non-root nodes, and 31 raw PortConnection declarations.
findings.requested_change: Select architecture_node_count 9, generated_support_usage_count 1, generated_support_route_count 10, source_port_connection_declaration_count 31, and containment depth 2; tag all support elements and preserve PART-01..08, INT-01..21, and the semantic 8/21/20/7 tuple unchanged.

findings.evidence: Current GUMBO repair evidence reports GclResolver feature-redeclaration failures when enum classifiers are reused across Data attributes. TYPE-08 repeats ChargeSessionState and CTRL-04 repeats session/disposition classifiers across records; retained accepted sources avoid this with field-specific enum classifiers.
findings.requested_change: Revise only TYPE-08/CTRL-04 representation to distinct snapshot-pre, snapshot-next, pilot-session, snapshot-disposition, and pilot-disposition enum classifiers with extensionally identical literals; keep fields as attributes and give all one-to-one projection clauses zero owner, semantic, or case credit.

findings.evidence: Literal enumeration of BEH-STATUS-01 leaves 108 of 1,620 structural inputs undefined when assessment is LOW/ADEQUATE, disposition is RECOVERY_APPLIED, and reason is NONE/CANCELLED; PilotAdvisory has no corresponding recovery value for those reasons.
findings.requested_change: Clarify PRI-03 and CASE-20 so only the three explicit recovery reasons take the recovery branch and NONE/CANCELLED fall through the existing remaining priorities; retain one CASE-20, check the producer invariant, enumerate all 1,620 inputs, and preserve all 720 end-to-end and scenario results.

findings.evidence: Extensional audit finds substantive local relations for all eight PARTs: 4-to-3 battery classification, 15-input contextual applicability, 4-to-3 charger classification, 27-to-7 state-dependent eligibility/recovery, 21-to-9 priority arbitration, 27 state/decision transitions, 15-to-4 notice classification, and multi-input advisory precedence. Readiness renaming, snapshot projections, and copied pilot-status fields are explicitly excluded from credit.

Retained well-formed sources demonstrate Data attributes, local state, initialization, compute cases, multi-output guarantees, In(state) pre-state publication, and the same state-broken feedback topology as INT-14. The current harness has a 180-second analyzer watchdog; retained analysis handles larger 3,240 end-to-end and 24,750 local products than the planned 720 and 1,620 products.
